$comment: Anatomia program layers (the dual-layer gate). A glob matches a repo-relative file path exactly (`*` = one level, `**` = any depth). Anatomia's module is a directory, so native/ has one `<dir>/*` rule per directory and the rules never overlap (the loader sorts globs and the first match wins). native/: the wire protocol shared by every program is shared; pure cores without sockets or clocks (lesson/core, presenter/core, program/core) are domain-logic; directories that compose a service or app around a core (relay, lesson service + HTTP/WebSocket transport + CLI, presenter/app, program/app) are application; OS and network adapters (platform/*, transport) are infrastructure; embedded browser pages and the program's renderer are presentation; native/tests and the lesson's manual end-to-end and attend harnesses are test. Check with `anatomia domains program --repo .` that native/ has no unclassified module.
